question: For Dragon Tail’s unresolved hit/payment edges, should Sanctuary use this rule: charges bypass the accuracy roll, shield block/dodge still apply, charges are consumed only on a successful contact, and a released kick costs 10 mana even if it misses? This is a design choice, not a request for an in-game test.
rules: An active martial charge bypasses Dragon Tail’s accuracy roll. It does not bypass shield block or dodge.
A successful contact consumes one charge from each participating charge state. Missed, blocked, dodged or cancelled contacts retain charges.
A released Dragon Tail kick costs 10 mana even if it misses. An interrupted windup has not released a kick.
Existing insufficient-mana Basic Attack fallback and world hostility rules remain in force.
stillUncertain: Exact D2R charged hit/block/dodge, consumption and miss-payment branches are superseded by these approved rules only.
Current executable packet/event/mode ordering, overflow behavior, native input and final art still need separate evidence; this decision does not certify the entire skill.
